# EditableField ## Summary Inline click-to-edit wrapper used across the blog: renders a `<:display>` block until activated (click / Enter / Space, `role='button'`), then swaps to `<:edit>` and blurs back on outside click. This is what makes the BlogPost isolated view the editor. ## Import ```js import { EditableField } from '../components/editable-field'; ``` ## Usage ```handlebars <:display>

<@fields.cardTitle />

<:edit><@fields.headline @format='edit' /> ```
